title: File:Courmayeur view.jpg
claims: The Commons file is a daylight panorama of Courmayeur and the surrounding mountain, showing the town's low-rise buildings, road, grass and lamp posts.
The file is a location photograph of the TDS start town, not a photograph of the TDS race; the file metadata contains no race or event context.
The author is Tiia Monto, credited under CC BY-SA 3.0; the original file is 8,445 x 3,073 pixels, 5,351,524 bytes, dated 2015-05-09.
The file page requires attribution and share-alike; the route page uses a 960 x 349 Commons thumbnail of 115,340 bytes and credits the author and licence.
